recent_picks.recommendation: Buy foil copies of Transguild Courier.

entry_target.raw: somewhere between $3 to $6, I'm putting it down four and splitting the difference

reasoning: Synergizes perfectly with the new five-color artifact commander Karn, the Gilded Guardian by providing all five colors on one card
Foils of this older uncommon are nearly nonexistent, with only 20 vendors having LP/NM copies
caveats: Karn may not be the top built commander from the set
recent_picks.evidence_excerpt: foils are nearly nonexistent... you can spend somewhere between $3 to $6, I'm putting it down four... this should become a $10 card

episode.title: MTG Fast Finance EP 536: Reality Fracture Top Cards

reasoning: Thranduil is the number two commander of the month and likely top 10 for the year

caveats: Some players might prefer other elf commanders like Lathril

episode.title: MTG Fast Finance EP 536: Reality Fracture Top Cards

recent_picks.recommendation: Buy foil borderless copies of Elminster.
reasoning: Synergizes extremely well as peanut butter and jelly with the new Reality Fracture sphinx Denzilor
Very tiny supply of foils with only 22 listings available
Elminster is a major wizard in D&D lore with a dedicated fan base
caveats: Denzilor might not get widely built
Deep inventory exists on non-foil copies
recent_picks.evidence_excerpt: You can get foil borderless copies around six bucks... I think this goes from six to 20 just on the tiny supply available

episode.title: MTG Fast Finance EP 536: Reality Fracture Top Cards

recent_picks.recommendation: Buy borderless foil copies of Y'shtola.
reasoning: Y'shtola is the number one most played commander of the year
Very low supply with only around 10 near mint listings for borderless foils
Hard to reprint easily due to Final Fantasy IP
caveats: Wizards could print a premium Secret Lair deck for her
They might print a better generic Esper commander
recent_picks.evidence_excerpt: Y'shtola borderless surge foil is now pushing $1500... getting in even late now at 400... borderless foils can get to 6 or 800.
